About the Role

We're seeking a talented Fullstack WordPress Developer with strong expertise in custom theme and plugin development. You'll work on WordPress projects, including theme and plugin development, and potentially some Joomla projects (with appropriate support, depending on your familiarity).

This is a contract role for full-time work over a 5 month contract.

However, you'll work as if you were a full-time employee, participating in team meetings, communicating via Slack, and coordinating with other people on our team.

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Build custom WordPress themes that closely match designs with meticulous attention to detail
  • Develop custom WordPress plugins with clean, well-structured code
  • Take ownership of WordPress projects from concept to completion
  • Refactor and update existing themes and templates
  • Address other occasional full-stack developer tasks as needed for non-WordPress systems and situations (e.g. newsletter development)
  • Provide limited support for clients who have issues or problems (secondary responsibility)

 

Work Hours & Meetings

You must be available to participate in meetings between 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM Los Angeles time (UTC-8)

Your work hours will be negotiable. However, this is a full-time position, and the condition of this contract work is that you only work on our projects and on a full-time basis. Preference will be given to candidates that can closely align with our US timezone schedule.

You have:

  1. At least 4 years of experience building custom WordPress themes and plugins
  2. Strong front-end development skills with an eye for detail
  3. Deep understanding of code organization, patterns, and OOP
  4. Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
  5. The ability to work independently and complete objectives without explicit direction
  6. The ability to deliver polished work, self-review, and catch bugs before others do. This means that for any front-end development you do, it should be near pixel-perfect in alignment with the design you're working from.

Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity

  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits

  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

Authenticated experience

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

Roles & rules

  • user:

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

jobs.description_html:
At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

The role

As Head of Medical Coding, Germany, you will be our German coding authority and the first coding expert on our founding German team. You will teach our AI engineers how German DRG coding really works, settle the hard cases, and make sure every suggestion we make holds up in an MD audit. You are the German equivalent of the DIM physician who helped us build Parallel in France.

Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in Germany in 2027.

  • Reports to: Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, until the GM Germany joins. You work closely with Dr. Quentin Jarrion, our physician coding lead in France.

  • Location: Berlin or Munich, hybrid. Travel up to 40% (pilot hospitals, DGfM events), plus 2 to 4 weeks of onboarding in Paris.

  • Team: you will recruit and lead our German coders (Kodierfachkräfte) as pilots scale.

Your mission for 2027: make our German coding logic accurate and defensible enough that Medizincontrolling teams trust it, and be the person who proves it to them.

What you will do

  1. Build our German coding logic with our AI engineers

    • Turn the Deutsche Kodierrichtlinien (DKR), ICD-10-GM, OPS and aG-DRG logic into rules and specs our engineers can build on.

    • Write annotation guidelines and build the German test sets our models are measured against.

    • Review model errors every week, explain why they are wrong, and flag the edge cases that hurt accuracy.

  2. Settle the hard cases

    • Be our reference on principal diagnosis, PCCL-relevant secondary diagnoses and OPS complex procedure codes (Komplexbehandlungen), using the SEG 4 and FoKA coding recommendations.

  3. Make every suggestion defensible in MD audits

    • Pre-bill only (§17c KHG): every suggestion supported by documentation, with an audit trail.

    • Help design our MD audit defense product (justifications for the MD, objections).

  4. Make pilots succeed

    • Analyze each hospital's Medizincontrolling workflows before go-live.

    • Run second-level review before our suggestions reach the hospital's coders.

    • Present results to the head of Medizincontrolling and get their sign-off for go-live.

    • Join sales meetings to show what our coding looks like up close.

  5. Build the German coding team

    • Recruit and lead Kodierfachkräfte as pilots scale, with our team of 20 coding experts in France.

Who you are

Experience

  • 5 to 10 years in Medizincontrolling or coding in German acute hospitals, including MD audits and objection procedures.

  • A physician or nursing background, and a qualification as Kodierfachkraft or Medizincontroller:in.

  • Experience at a coding, Medizincontrolling or billing software vendor (for example ID Berlin, Tiplu, Damedic, Solventum) is a big plus.

  • You have seen several hospitals: through a hospital group, consulting or a vendor.

Mindset

  • Expert and rigorous: you settle hard cases with references, not opinions.

  • Curious about AI: you want to shape how it is used in coding, not just judge it.

  • Clear communicator: you explain complex coding decisions to engineers and to heads of Medizincontrolling alike.

  • Builder: you are comfortable starting from scratch in a startup.

Languages

  • Native German, fluent English (our working language with Paris).

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (30 min).

  2. Case (60-90 min): two hard cases and one AI error to fix

  3. Working session with one of our AI engineers, including a third case live.

  4. Call with Paul (CEO) and Dr. Quentin Jarrion, then references.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.
If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

  • Support fundraising and investor narrative: Contribute country and market insights to investor updates and board materials

  • You have hands-on experience in launching a product or business in a new European market, ideally in fintech, payments or capital markets

  • You have regulatory & financial literacy with a strong understanding of how regulation shapes market entry for a regulated financial business. You are comfortable engaging directly with regulators and compliance teams

  • You have a strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional programmes end-to-end, from scoping and sequencing to delivery across multiple stakeholders. You are comfortable in taking decisions and show true ownership

  • You have demonstrated strong leadership and communication skills, effectively engaging internal and external stakeholders to drive change

  • You are analytical & show commercial acumen: You are structured and numbers-driven, comfortable building business cases, market sizing and competitive analysis, and working with budgets and repeatable launch playbooks

  • You enjoy building relationships with clients/partners and have experience working with them collaboratively to solve problems and achieve shared goals

  • You are AI-native - you use AI tools proactively in your day-to-day work (synthesis, reporting, research) and are always looking for smarter, faster ways of working

  • Location: Berlin-based. German and English are must-have. It’s great if you speak additional European languages relevant to Upvest's target expansion markets

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

What to expect

  • Process Map: Du baust die End-to-End-Prozesslandschaft unseres Operations Department auf und hältst sie aktuell. Dabei startest du beim Big Picture und gehst dort in die Tiefe, wo Teams Arbeit aneinander übergeben.

  • Prozess-Redesign: Gemeinsam mit den Teams findest du heraus, wo es hakt und warum. Daraus entwickelst du Zielprozesse, die über Teams und Länder hinweg funktionieren.

  • AI-First: Für jeden Prozessschritt entscheidest du: streichen, vereinfachen, an AI übergeben oder automatisieren. Du schreibst die Anforderungen für unsere AI- und Automation-Kolleg:innen und testest, was sie liefern.

  • Standards & Ownership: Mit den Leads legst du Prozessstandards fest und benennst klare Process Owner. So wird Continuous Improvement Teil des Alltags.

  • Projekte: Projekte rund um Prozesse, Rollen und Change leitest du selbst. Bei technischen Projekten bist du von Anfang an dabei und gestaltest die Prozessseite mit.

  • Messbarer Impact: Du machst sichtbar, was deine Arbeit bewirkt, zum Beispiel kürzere Durchlaufzeiten, weniger manuelle Arbeit und mehr dokumentierte Kernprozesse mit klarem Owner.

  • Aufbauarbeit: Als erste Person mit vollem Prozessfokus legst du die Grundlagen. Du entscheidest mit, mit welchen Methoden und Templates wir arbeiten und wie wir Projekte aufsetzen und übergeben.

Inspire us by

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Prozess- oder Operations-Beratung, Operational Excellence, Business Process Management oder einer operativen Rolle mit Prozessverantwortung. Das Level richten wir nach deiner Erfahrung aus.

  • Track Record: Du hast mehrere teamübergreifende Prozess-Redesigns geleitet und kannst zeigen, was sich dadurch messbar verbessert hat.

  • AI & Automation: Du arbeitest täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und weißt, was AI-Agenten und Low-Code-Tools wie Make oder n8n leisten können. So schreibst du Anforderungen, mit denen unsere Builder direkt arbeiten können.

  • Change & Stakeholder Management: Du hast Prozesse auch gegen Widerstände verändert und überzeugst Heads genauso wie operative Teams. Workshops mit Senior Stakeholdern moderierst du souverän und hältst Entscheidungen verbindlich fest.

  • Pragmatische Methodik: Du kennst Swimlanes, BPMN oder Lean und setzt sie dort ein, wo sie Entscheidungen erleichtern. Ein funktionierender Prozess ist dir wichtiger als ein perfektes Diagramm.

  • Datengetrieben: Du nutzt Daten, um Probleme zu erkennen und Verbesserungen zu belegen, und arbeitest sicher mit BI-Tools.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und bist an unseren Anchor Days (Dienstag bis Donnerstag) gerne in unserem Münchner Office.

  • Hands-on: Du hast schon selbst kleine Automatisierungen oder AI-Assistenten gebaut.

  • Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, VWL oder einem ähnlichen Fach.

  • Ownership & Gestaltungsspielraum: Dein Impact, deine Bilanz - Übernimm volle Ownership für deinen Bereich und deine KPIs

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. By empowering FinTechs, Banks and Wealth Managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets provides a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform for simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.

We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that, we make investing seamlessly accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional people like you.

 

Your Mission:

You’ll join our Product Engineering organisation as an Engineering Manager in the Customer Lifecycle domain, where you’ll lead one engineering team end-to-end from day one. The domain is responsible for the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding, identity verification (KYC), anti-money laundering (AML) screening, account management, and offboarding.

As the Engineering Manager of the Customer Lifecycle domain, your mission is to inspire and guide engineers to grow individually and within the organisation, raising the bar on operational excellence, automation and risk management in a highly regulated environment. You are ready to drive change, simplify complex systems and experiment in search of the best solutions for our partners, our operations teams and our regulators.

You’ll build a strong understanding of your domain’s product and business context, and use this knowledge to guide your teams. There will be strong engineers in your teams who take day-to-day ownership for technical design, standards and delivery quality, while you focus on creating the environment, clarity and structure in which they (and the whole team) can excel.

This is your opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and collaborate with experienced professionals from Product, Brokerage and Operations, building upon your previous experiences to build the investment infrastructure for the next 100 million retail investors in Europe.

 

You will:

50% Shipping value: Own engineering outcomes and operational health in your domain. Set clear goals with Product and Operations, ruthlessly drive focus and clarity, and remove blockers so engineers can ship valuable work consistently.

40% Growing people: Hire, develop and retain engineers, growing the next generation of technical leaders. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback and manage performance. Create a high‑energy environment where strong people want to join, stay and grow.

10% Engaging technically: Stay close enough to the code and systems to earn the respect of senior ICs. You fly high but can dive deep: reviewing designs, engaging in technical discovery and incident follow‑ups, and using your technical judgment to ask sharp questions and make trade‑offs.

  • Drive focus and closure. Shape your teams’ ways of working so that they tackle a small number of high‑impact initiatives at a time, and push dependencies, blockers or incidents, to clear decisions and outcomes.

  • Partner with Product and Operations to define the strategy and goals for your domain.

  • Raise the bar on quality, reliability, and security. Co-own domain posture with senior ICs and ensure big technical work is justified and deliverable.

  • Grow strong ICs into leaders. Identify high‑potential engineers and give them clear ownership, stretch projects, and feedback so they can grow into Senior+ roles.

  • Foster trust, productive conflict, and knowledge sharing within your teams. Build trust, productive conflict, and knowledge sharing. Celebrate wins and clearly communicate your team’s impact cross-functionally.

  • Expand your team with great engineers. Work with senior leadership on headcount, team structure, and role definitions as we scale

  • Partner with Operations to identify possibilities to improve operational efficiency.

     

You will be successful in this role if:

  • You have gained profound technical leadership experience as Engineering Manager or Head of Engineering. You have led and grown one or more backend-heavy teams in a fast-paced environment and achieved ambitious goals.

  • Brokerage, payment, or financial services excite you. Ideally, you had prior touch points to Fintech professionally.

  • Have solid experience with API-first, cloud-based architectures, and know what good looks like in terms of reliability, observability, security, and incident response in production systems.

  • You take pride in being technical. You can read and review well-structured, tested code in a modern high-level language, challenge designs and trade-offs, and bring a pragmatic engineering perspective to product discussions without needing to be the primary implementer.

  • You have a deep understanding of software development processes and their failure modes, and know how to set a team up for success.

  • You are an empathic leader that can inspire others. You know how to encourage strong (cross-functional) collaboration, develop your team members and foster a strong sense of collaboration across the whole team.

  • You have an intrinsic motivation to understand the product and business side of things. You are keen to contribute to & influence the wider company direction and culture.

    We're looking for people with passion, desire to learn and that are team players. You're encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out - and set you apart - especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns.

How we Take Care of You:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

ABOUT THE ROLE.

We are searching for a driven and skillful Key Account Manager to work alongside and grow Halter’s enterprise beef customers across New Zealand. We’re looking for someone with beef systems knowledge, commercial nous, X-factor communication skills, and the ability to drive change and communicate value.

You will be managing a portfolio of large corporate beef operations and stations, from phase one rollout through to full-scale integration with Halter technology. You will be driving the success and growth of Halter within these accounts.

You’ll be an expert at building trusting relationships, identifying opportunities within a farming system to add value, and enjoy driving the growth of the largest agricultural businesses in New Zealand. You’ll thrive in high-pressure environments, using initiative to make results happen, often against the odds. You might find yourself in a boardroom assisting the negotiating of a million-dollar contract one day, reporting key KPI’s to a GM the next day, communicating opportunities and driving change with Farm and Station Managers by Friday. You’ll masterfully navigate layers within these businesses, adjusting your communication at each level accordingly, to convey the right context and value to all parties. You’ll likely have deep extensive farming systems knowledge and have a natural ability to drive change at a farm and leadership level.

This isn’t a typical role. This is a high-stakes role, playing a critical role in Halter’s growth into the enterprise segment in New Zealand.

Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster, you will be making a real-world impact, helping large scale beef businesses transform how they operate to become more efficient and productive. You will build relationships across some of the most influential beef businesses in New Zealand while working closely with Halter senior leadership. Up for the challenge? Let’s talk.

This role covers customers across New Zealand. Frequent travel is required as part of this position.

WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE.

  • Enterprise Customer Success: You’ll be embedded in the success of some of Halter’s largest and most strategic customers, ensuring our enterprise beef businesses realise full value from their investment. You’ll understand their goals and farm system deeply, help them embed Halter into daily operations, and surface impact across the business. Your efforts will directly influence execution, retention, expansion, and long-term growth.

  • Strategic Account Management: You’ll build trusted, long-term relationships with farm and station teams, operational teams and executive stakeholders alike. You’ll know when to guide, when to challenge, and when to step in to unlock new value. This isn’t just about managing relationships; it’s about owning customer outcomes.

  • Executive Engagement: In collaboration with the Enterprise Sales Manager you will work directly with senior leaders and multi-entity decision-makers. You’ll understand the organisational structure, surface strategic pain points, and partner with the Enterprise Sales Manager to tailor solutions that move the needle. With the Enterprise Sales Manager, you’ll also play a key role in supporting expansion and renewal conversations.

  • Influencer & Network Management: You won’t stop with your customer. You’ll build relationships with rural professionals, consultants, and other industry influencers who shape opinion, success on farm and purchasing behaviour across your portfolio. You’ll be known and respected in the region as a trusted Halter advisor.

  • Enterprise Growth Strategy: You’ll collaborate with the NZ Enterprise Sales Manager to co-create account plans, drive territory expansion, and identify new revenue streams within your customer base. You’ll know your portfolio inside-out and play a key role in shaping how we grow our enterprise presence in-market.

  • Cross-functional Leadership: You’ll work closely with Halter’s product, support, and sales teams to champion your accounts internally. Whether it’s surfacing product feedback, coordinating training, or aligning on rollout strategy, you’ll be the glue that holds enterprise relationships together and drives results.

  • Forecasting & Planning: Alongside the Enterprise Sales Manager, you’ll contribute to accurate revenue forecasting and strategic planning. You’ll bring rigour to account performance tracking and identify early signals of both risk and growth.

  • Scalable Growth Initiatives: You’ll help evolve how we support and grow our largest customers. From refining account management strategies to building scalable playbooks, you’ll be part of the team shaping what great looks like as Halter scales globally.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR.

  • Enterprise experience: You’ve managed large, complex accounts and know how to drive growth over time. You’re comfortable navigating executive rooms, operational teams, farm and station teams, multiple stakeholders, and matrixed business structures.

  • Customer centric: You’re relentlessly farmer-first. You anticipate needs, address problems early, and are accountable for continuously improving customer satisfaction.

  • Industry fluency: You bring real experience in beef production systems and know what success looks like on high performing beef farms and stations. You’re credible, informed, and customer-first.

  • Strong commercial instincts: You don’t just nurture relationships; you find value, expand accounts, and deliver results.

  • Team-first mindset: You collaborate across roles and functions to get the best outcome for the customer and the company.

  • Autonomy & pace: You’re happy working independently in a fast-changing environment. You solve problems proactively and adjust quickly.

  • Growth hunger: You’re looking to stretch yourself, take on more, and grow your career alongside a world-class commercial team.

  • Travel-ready: You’ll regularly be out with customers, in the room, the paddock, or the boardroom when it counts. Expected travel up to 50% of the time.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

Job Summary:

The EUS Program Manager (EUSPM) ensures the EUS program meets the high expectations of our clients by continuously improving in service efficiency and customer experience. This multi-faceted role focuses on managing all key operational components of running the End User Support line of business.

How Will I Make an Impact?:

Headquarters: Remote (Canada)

About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the role:

An indispensable component of Clipboard's marketplace is its workplace customers. The Customer Success Manager ensures the continued success of the partnership between Clipboard and its workplace partners, working to deliver an optimal experience at every level of their organizations. The job encompasses being a resource to workplaces when issues arise, liaising with building- and corporate-level contacts, and keeping abreast of a litany of important business metrics for each account.

Your week will be balanced between high-touch customer engagement and internal account strategy, with a laser focus on net revenue retention. You are an avid problem-solver, a strategic communicator, and a diligent executor who can navigate complex relationships to sharpen your business acumen.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage & grow your portfolio: Own a book of business with accountability for "Same-Store Shift Postings" (SSSP, which measures utilization) and "Same-Store Net Revenue" (SSNR, which measures profitability). In your pursuit of driving those numbers higher, you will identify churn risks, mitigate issues, and proactively uncover opportunities for commercial expansion.

  • Strategic account planning: Build and maintain detailed account plans. Forecast performance accurately and provide regular insights to internal leadership regarding pipeline health and account stability.

  • Drive executive value: Establish trust with both clinical and non-clinical executives. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and strategic meetings to demonstrate value, align on business goals, and negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes.

  • Operational excellence: Act as the primary point of contact for complex escalations, ensuring rapid resolution while implementing systemic solutions to prevent recurrence.

  • Cross-functional advocacy: Partner with Product, Legal, and Strategy Operations to represent the voice of the customer, driving product improvements and internal initiatives that optimize the client experience.

Beyond the basics, what will make you successful:

  • Extreme ownership: The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You're self-reliant, and can get things done in the chaos that is an early-stage startup scaling quickly.

  • Extreme curiosity: You ask "why" 3-5 times in a row for the same problem, digging and digging and not being satisfied until you truly understand the root cause.

  • Scrappiness: You look for ways through problems and refuse to let obstacles derail your progress. You bring solutions instead of asking ‘what should I do?’

  • Fast-paced: You thrive on moving quickly and are highly adaptable to a market that evolves quickly.

Our interview process:

  1. Application (where you are now!)

  2. Case study

  3. Interview 1 with a hiring manager

  4. Interview 2 with Head of Account Management

  5. Culture chat with a partner on our People Team

Why a case study first?

Since this role is remote and requires a high degree of autonomy, the case study helps us understand how you operate in an asynchronous environment. Specifically, we’re looking at how you interpret written context, navigate ambiguity, and identify opportunities independently. This ensures our first conversation is grounded in your actual work style rather than just a resume walkthrough.

Qualifications:

  • Relationship management experience not required but strongly preferred

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Willingness to try / lack of fear

  • Bachelor's Degree

Benefits:

  • Do great work that matters for customers who could really use your help

  • Competitive pay

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Fully Remote

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

À propos du poste

HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions) est la division B2B de Hopper et propulse des solutions d'IA pour le voyage auprès de grandes compagnies aériennes, d'hôtels et d'institutions financières partout dans le monde. L'équipe est restreinte et expérimentée, les responsabilités sont vastes, et on s'attend à ce que la personne retenue assume à la fois la stratégie et l'exécution.

À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien

  • Piloter la stratégie de marketing numérique B2B de HTS en établissant les priorités de canaux, les budgets et les objectifs liés au pipeline et aux revenus

  • Planifier, lancer et optimiser des campagnes payantes sur LinkedIn, Google Ads et d'autres canaux numériques, de la définition des audiences et de la création jusqu'à la production de rapports

  • Concevoir et mener de bout en bout des programmes de génération de leads, en collaboration avec les Ventes pour définir la qualité des leads et l'améliorer continuellement

  • Assumer la responsabilité de LinkedIn payant comme canal B2B central : gérer le contenu sponsorisé (Sponsored Content), les formulaires de génération de leads (Lead Gen Forms) et le ciblage d'audiences de type ABM pour rejoindre les décideurs de haut niveau des compagnies aériennes, des hôtels et des institutions financières, et tester continuellement les créatifs et les formats pour améliorer la qualité des leads

  • Concevoir du contenu pour les campagnes numériques, y compris du contenu pour les médias sociaux, des annonces de recherche et plus encore

  • Réaliser des tests A/B sur le contenu et les formats publicitaires afin d'optimiser la génération de leads et la conversion

  • Tester et déployer à grande échelle de nouveaux canaux et de nouvelles tactiques, et savoir quand abandonner ce qui ne fonctionne pas

  • Suivre, analyser et rendre compte de la performance, notamment le coût par lead, les taux de conversion et la contribution au pipeline, et transformer les données en recommandations claires pour l'équipe

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Produit, Ventes, Affaires juridiques et Communications afin d'assurer la cohérence des messages et l'alignement des campagnes sur les priorités de l'entreprise

  • Privilégier la qualité plutôt que la quantité en optimisant les campagnes pour les leads qualifiés par les Ventes (SQL) plutôt que pour le volume brut, et en travaillant avec les Ventes pour affiner continuellement le ciblage, les messages et les critères de leads afin que les efforts marketing se traduisent en véritable pipeline

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Marketing et Communications tout en jouissant d'un haut degré d'autonomie

  • Rendre compte de la performance numérique à la haute direction en traduisant les indicateurs de canal, comme le coût par lead, les taux de conversion et la contribution au pipeline, en constats et recommandations clairs qui orientent les investissements et la stratégie marketing

  • Collaborer avec les Ventes, la direction et l'équipe Marketing et Communications pour établir la stratégie et le processus de suivi des leads marketing tout au long du pipeline de vente

  • Fournir des analyses complètes sur l'influence des campagnes marketing sur la progression du pipeline et sur les revenus

  • Possibilité de soutenir, au fil du temps, la croissance auprès des partenaires existants au moyen de campagnes d'expansion et de lancements de produits conjoints avec les équipes partenaires et les Communications

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

  • Maîtrise de HubSpot, de Salesforce et de GA4, avec la capacité de gérer le flux de leads, l'attribution et la production de rapports de performance sur l'ensemble de l'entonnoir

  • Excellentes habiletés de communication écrite et orale, et capacité de collaborer entre les équipes et avec des parties prenantes de haut niveau

  • Une expérience dans les secteurs de la technologie, du voyage ou dans des environnements B2B constitue un atout important

Chez Hopper, nous bâtissons la plateforme technologique de voyage de référence à l'échelle mondiale, et nous le faisons en résolvant de vrais problèmes pour de vrais voyageurs, partout sur la planète. Nos plateformes de réservation grand public Hopper et notre division B2B, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), travaillent en synergie pour offrir aux voyageurs transparence, flexibilité et de véritables économies à chaque séjour. Pour y parvenir, nous combinons d'immenses volumes de données et l'intelligence artificielle à des produits fintech exclusifs. Nous ne sommes pas simplement un moteur de réservation de plus : nous offrons une façon fondamentalement meilleure de planifier et de vivre le voyage pour nos clients et nos partenaires. jobs.description_html:
Headquarters: England

About Docker

Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Role

As a Renewals Manager at Docker, you will be responsible for driving the renewal process for our customers, ensuring that they continue to see the value in our products and services. You will work closely with our Account Executives and customers to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, and to negotiate and close renewal contracts.

A successful Renewals Manager at Docker will be able to build strong relationships with customers and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. They will have a deep understanding of our products and services, and be able to articulate the value that we provide to our customers. They will be proactive and able to manage multiple accounts simultaneously, while also being able to identify and prioritize opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.

Please note: French and English language fluency is a requirement for this role.

_______________________________________________________________________

Responsibilities

  • Manage the renewal process for a portfolio of customers end-to-end, ensuring timely and accurate renewals.

  • Build strong relationships with customers, and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.

  • Negotiate and close renewal contracts on time, working closely with Account Executives or independently.

  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, articulating the value that we provide to our customers.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that customer needs are met and issues are resolved.

  • Identify and mitigate churn risk early by taking ownership over outreach, data review and other signals

  • Maintain accurate forecasts and Salesforce hygiene according to provide clear visibility into risk and outcomes

_______________________________________________________________________

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in a sales or account management role preferably in a SaaS company, but not required.

  • Experience working with Mid Market and Enterprise level accounts

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to build strong relationships with customers.

  • Proactive and able to manage multiple accounts simultaneously.

  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM tools is a plus.

  • French and English language fluency

_______________________________________________________________________

What to expect in the first 30 days

  • Onboarding and training on Docker's products and services.

  • Introduction to the Renewals team and cross-functional teams.

  • Review of current customer portfolio and renewal pipeline.

What to expect in the first 90 days

  • Management of a portfolio of customers and renewals.

  • Identification and pursuit of upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams to resolve customer issues and meet customer needs.

What to expect in the first year

  • Continued management of a portfolio of customers and renewals, with a focus on driving customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

  • Identification and pursuit of strategic opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.

  • Active participation in cross-functional projects to improve the customer experience.

Visa sponsorship: Not available for this role.

_______________________________________________________________________

 

Compensation & Equity

All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

 

Europe: €85.4K – €122K OTE

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

#LI-REMOTE
